_purpose: Historical monsoon intensity for Nashik, by week, used by the crowd model's monsoon modifier.
_STATUS: PLACEHOLDER - NOT SOURCED IMD DATA. The values below are a coarse shape from general SW-monsoon climatology (onset ~mid-June, peak July–August, retreat late September). They must be REPLACED with sourced IMD Nashik historical weekly/monthly rainfall normals, and the peak weeks re-derived FROM the data (do not assume). Until then the monsoon modifier's magnitude should be treated as low-confidence. See UNVERIFIED.md #13.
intensity_scale: one of: peak | high | moderate | low | dry - mapped to weights in crowd-model/weights.config.json:monsoon_intensity

weekly_overrides._note: Optional finer overrides keyed by ISO week number once real IMD weekly normals are loaded. Empty until sourced.
